description: Turn WORDS into MINTS via Jupiter (GET /assets/search). Any basket idea — "AI tokens", "DePIN", "BONK", "something like JUP" — starts here. Returns mint, symbol, name, decimals and asset class. This is the ONLY legitimate way to obtain a mint address: never type one from memory, and always resolve a pasted one before using it — tickers collide and impersonation is routine. DECIMALS ARE NOT COSMETIC: every onchain amount is raw integer units, and a 6-decimal token differs from a 9-decimal one by 1000x. Returns the top `limit` matches (default 10, max 50) as lean rows, with `basketEligibility` — a token missing from the results may simply not be holdable by a fund (e.g. wSOL, or Token-2022 with non-allowlisted extensions).

assetClass.description: Optional filter: lst (liquid staking) | spot (regular tokens) | fun (pump.fun) | stable | ybt (yield-bearing) | rwa (tokenized real-world assets)
